tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The ground of every screen. Never put body text on anything lighter than label.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: panels, song cards, secondary buttons, selects, the tape label. Always with a 2px ink outline.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Sunken fills: progress-bar track, countdown remainder, canvas behind showcase boards. Never a text ground for small text below 13px.

tokens.name: sand-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines on small chips and the year chips in Standings. Decorative only — never a control border.

tokens.name: slot-empty
tokens.usage: Unfilled segments in the 10-segment Standings progress.

tokens.name: slot-dash
tokens.usage: Dashed outline of an empty timeline gap. Decorative (2.1:1 on paper); the gap's + icon and label carry the meaning.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text, every 2px outline, every hard sticker shadow, focus rings. 14:1 on paper, 4.6:1 on coral, 8.2:1 on mustard.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: artist names, meta lines, 'no phone'. 7:1 on paper and label.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text such as 'Passed' and '/10'. 5.2:1 on paper.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: THE action colour: primary buttons, the logo pill, the tape shell, progress fill, countdown elapsed. Text on coral is always ink, never white.

tokens.name: coral-text
tokens.usage: Coral when it has to be text on paper or label (mono labels like CHALLENGE WINDOW, links). 4.9:1 on paper.

tokens.name: coral-deep
tokens.usage: Shade of coral: the lower lip of the cassette, pressed primary buttons.

tokens.name: mustard
tokens.usage: The mystery: the pick being placed or guessed right now (and that guesser's row), and tokens (the coin dot). Ink text only.

tokens.name: turn-tint
tokens.usage: Background of whatever belongs to the player on turn: their scoreboard row, the card just won, and picks already locked in. Ink text.

tokens.name: right
tokens.usage: A right placement or guess after the reveal: the Right verdict pill and the ✓ mark. Ink text and icon on top (7:1). Always with ✓ and an initial or word.

tokens.name: wrong
tokens.usage: A wrong guess after the reveal: the ✕ mark. Paper text on top (5.9:1). Much darker than coral and right, so the two read apart by lightness, not hue.

tokens.name: tape-brown
tokens.usage: Tape wound on the cassette reels. Only inside the TapePlayer.

tokens.name: tape-window
tokens.usage: The cassette's window behind the reels. Only inside the TapePlayer.

tokens.name: player-1
tokens.usage: Player colour 1 (avatar fill, 'via' dot, filled Standings segments). Ink text on top.

tokens.name: player-2
tokens.usage: Player colour 2, sage. Ink text on top.

tokens.name: player-3
tokens.usage: Player colour 3. Ink text on top.

tokens.name: player-4
tokens.usage: Player colour 4, lilac. Ink text on top.

tokens.name: player-5
tokens.usage: Player colour 5, sky. Ink text on top. Player colours are always paired with the player's initial or name — never the only cue.

styles.name: logo
styles.usage: The L2 wordmark in the phone header, inside the coral pill. Written lowercase in markup (screen readers say 'jamster'); Rubik Mono One draws it in capitals.

styles.name: logo-xl
styles.usage: The wordmark on join/landing screens, TV idle and the repo hero.

styles.name: tape-year
styles.usage: The tape label in SVG units (300×190 cassette): '????' while the song is a mystery, the year after the reveal. Same face and size for both, so the four marks line up like digits.

styles.name: moment
styles.usage: The one sentence in the moment panel that says what's happening or asks the question. One line.

styles.name: year
styles.usage: Release year on a song card. Tabular figures.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: 17px: small headlines. The moment panel's sentence uses 'moment' (22px).

styles.name: name
styles.usage: Player names in challenger cells; 13px in Standings rows.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Meta lines and select text. The smallest size for anything a player must read to act.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels. Sentence case, verb first, one or two words.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Song title on a card; up to three lines.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Artist, 'via' line, 'no phone'. Always ink-muted or darker.

styles.name: label-caps
styles.usage: Tiny uppercase state labels above a headline, in coral-text.

styles.name: room-code
styles.usage: The four-letter room code chip; 28px+ on the lobby screen.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between Standings segments.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between paired buttons (Challenge + Pass), title-to-artist on cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap inside challenger cells and between them.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm of the screen (header → content → timeline), timeline card gap.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Panel side padding, header item gap.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between the main column and Standings, tape and challenge panel.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Screen padding top/bottom on a landscape phone.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Screen padding left/right on a landscape phone (add the safe-area inset on notched phones).

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Room-code chip, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-row
tokens.usage: Standings rows.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Song cards, challenger cells, square icon buttons, selects.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Panels: challenge window, Standings.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, the logo, status pills. Round icon buttons use 50%.

tokens.name: shadow-sticker-sm
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, the logo pill. Hard, no blur — the sticker look.

tokens.name: shadow-sticker
tokens.usage: Panels, song cards, the tape (as drop-shadow on the SVG).

tokens.name: shadow-sticker-lg
tokens.usage: Large-screen (laptop/TV) scale of the same shadow, and the big logo.

stroke.note: Every outlined element uses the same ink stroke. Thicker strokes only inside SVG units (the tape).

tokens.name: stroke-control
tokens.usage: Outline of buttons, panels, cards, avatars, chips, selects.

tilt.note: One angle for everything that tilts. Tilt marks the special things: the brand and the song in play. Nothing else rotates.

tokens.name: tilt
tokens.usage: The only rotation in Jamster, used by exactly three things: the logo pill, the cassette in the TapePlayer, and the mystery card in its gap.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable.

tokens.name: avatar
tokens.usage: Player avatar default; 26px in player cells and the library line, 22px in the scoreboard.

tokens.name: card-w
tokens.usage: Song card width on the board. Fixed; a timeline that doesn't fit scrolls sideways.

tokens.name: card-h
tokens.usage: Song card height on the board.

tokens.name: gap-w
tokens.usage: Width of a dashed + gap between cards. Its tap area reaches a few px past the dashes.

tokens.name: tape-w
tokens.usage: Rendered width of the cassette SVG (height 101px, 300×190 viewBox).

tokens.name: screen-w
tokens.usage: Design width: landscape phone (iPhone 14/15 class). Layouts scale up from here.

tokens.name: screen-h
tokens.usage: Design height: landscape phone.
